<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/pay/verify/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Verifies a payment by `reference`, records it, and fulfils (parcel paid / wallet credit) idempotently. A previously-recorded success is never downgraded; replaying a reference is safe (fulfilment happens once). On a non-success status it returns `statuscode` 99 "Payment not successful" with `transactionstatus` = Paystack's status. Returns the parcel `collectcode` for parcel payments. `amount`/`fees` are in XOF francs (major unit); `paidat` is ISO 8601 UTC.
